incidents.name: Incident on 2012-07-31 20:45:21 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-07-31 20:45:21 - We're investigating elevated failure rates on some of our file servers
  • 2012-07-31 21:17:20 - We're a bit behind on jobs at the moment. Workers are processing through the backlog now, and we'll update again when the queue is empty.
  • 2012-07-31 21:43:52 - File servers have recovered. We're still working through the backlog of background jobs.
  • 2012-07-31 22:45:01 - We've processed through the queue backlog successfully. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-07-25 20:09:44 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-07-25 20:09:44 - Some Pages are currently unavailable. We're rolling out a fix now.
  • 2012-07-25 20:12:01 - Service for all GitHub Pages has been restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-07-24 16:11:27 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-07-24 16:11:27 - We're testing a fix to continued SSH connection errors. More as we have it.
  • 2012-07-24 21:41:01 - We've significantly reduced the number of SSH connection errors today and are hard at work on a solution to eliminate them entirely.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-07-23 21:50:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-07-23 21:50:00 - We've tracked down the source of increased SSH connection errors some of you may have seen this afternoon. A fix is going out now.
  • 2012-07-23 22:29:57 - SSH connection fix has been deployed. Please email support@github.com if you're having trouble connecting via SSH!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-07-05 20:30:50 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-07-05 20:30:50 - A storage server is failing over. Some repositories are inaccessible. We're investigating now.
  • 2012-07-05 20:45:13 - All repositories are now accessible.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-06-28 16:25:57 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-06-28 16:25:57 - Investigating connectivity problems.
  • 2012-06-28 16:30:14 - All services back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-06-27 20:46:57 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-06-27 20:46:57 - Investigating connectivity problems.
  • 2012-06-27 20:59:25 - All services are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-06-22 13:40:52 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-06-22 13:40:52 - We received some reports of pushes not being accepted. We're investigating the problem.
  • 2012-06-22 13:41:23 - We have resolved the problem and all pushes should be accepted again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-06-06 18:49:32 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-06-06 18:49:32 - All rebuilds of failed page builds in the last few hours should be complete now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-06-06 18:06:03 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-06-06 18:06:03 - We're investigating some trouble with GitHub Pages. More as we have it.
  • 2012-06-06 18:33:45 - New page builds should be working again. We're working on rebuilding all of the pages that failed in the past few hours now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-25 13:30:33 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-25 13:30:33 - Investigating intermittent 'remote end hung up unexpectedly' errors
  • 2012-05-25 13:44:28 - All systems are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-13 05:45:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-13 05:45:00 - One of the frontend machines is not able to connect to the storage servers. A small percentage of all requests are impacted. If you see 500s, wait 60s and try again to land on a different frontend machine. We're investigating.
  • 2012-05-13 05:46:00 - All systems go!

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-12 17:26:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-05-12 17:26:00 - Some Time Warner Cable customers are experiencing problems accessing GitHub. Time Warner Cable is investigating, and we'll update here with any further information we receive from them.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-12 17:11:05 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-12 17:11:05 - Investigating connectivity issues.
  • 2012-05-12 17:25:00 - The site's back, sorry for the hiccup.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-10 20:05:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-10 20:05:00 - We're having some performance problems. Looking into it now.
  • 2012-05-10 20:49:00 - Performance issue has been isolated and services are returning to normal.
  • 2012-05-10 21:59:38 - All systems have recovered and are performing normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-09 12:21:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-09 12:21:00 - A small percentage of GitHub Pages may be experiencing degraded performance. We're investigating.
  • 2012-05-09 14:04:49 - GitHub Pages performance has stabilized.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-05-08 15:33:54 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-05-08 15:33:54 - Investigating the source intermittent SSH hangups.
  • 2012-05-08 15:47:21 - All service is back to normal.
